name: What maintenance is required after my home has been re-stuccoed?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required after my home has been re-stuccoed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining your re-stuccoed home is relatively straightforward. Regular cleaning is essential to prevent dirt, mildew, and algae buildup, typically done with a soft brush and mild detergent, or a low-pressure power washer. It's important to inspect the stucco periodically for any signs of hairline cracks or damage, especially after severe weather. Promptly address any issues to prevent water penetration. Proper drainage around your home and ensuring sprinklers do not constantly spray the stucco can also prolong its lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: After re-stucco, maintain your home by regularly cleaning the surface, inspecting for cracks, and ensuring proper drainage to prevent damage and prolong its lifespan.
